name: BaggageMishandlingClaimsDesk
tagline: Delayed, damaged, pilfered and lost bags – from PIR and tracing to a settled claim.
description: A complete airline baggage-services app for Power Apps and Power Pages: tracing clock and lost declaration, interim-expense allowance, Montreal Convention liability limit in SDR with special declarations, depreciation, claim time limits, settlement calculator, approval ladder with ex gratia control, document checklists and claim-risk scoring.
features: Tracing clock with day-21 lost declaration
Interim allowance with Pay interim and over-allowance block
Liability limit in SDR + declared value
Approval limits and ex gratia role
Undo, keyboard and touch, phone layout
react: 16.14.0 bundled (no platform library, no Fluent UI)
controlType: standard (2 controls: dataset + Power Pages field control, shared src/app)
